note: The deployed rule is the tabulated joint step function, so the projection psi_i - the minimum of the table over the other candidates' ratios - is exact rather than an approximation of some other object.  Rejection of candidate i implies T_i > psi_i, so the union of the per-candidate events bounds the FWER, and each term is a one-candidate supremum certified over the continuum by wb_certify.py.
comparison_fix: Gate X11 caught the comparison field measuring the wrong rule.  The certificates are unchanged - they never used it - and the field now carries the deployed rule's own FWER with its Monte-Carlo error.
